lines.meet: I'm Réka, a necromancer, and that's my crow. Don't stare at it, it's shy, and it was shy before it died too.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Black Strand, na, of course! I've seen you on the beach. I'm Réka, with the crow, and the crow's seen you too.
lines.ask_home: And where are you from? I'm curious what cartoons you watched as a child.
lines.ask_work: Your job, before all this? I'll guess first, and I'm usually wrong in funny ways.
lines.answer_home: Pécs, in Hungary, but I lived in Budapest, in a studio above a bakery.
lines.answer_work: Stop-motion films, twelve years, moving puppets a millimetre at a time and taking a picture. One of them won a prize at Annecy.
lines.chat_food: Fresh bread from the bakery downstairs at six in the morning, na, still warm. I woke up hungry for twelve years.
lines.chat_sleep: My crow sleeps worse than me, and I sleep badly. We keep each other up, mostly out of spite.
lines.chat_missing: My cat Kocka, who hated every puppet I ever made. She'd knock them off the table one by one.
lines.chat_here: Necromancy's exactly like stop-motion, if you ask me. Weight, timing and follow-through, every time.
lines.tease_quiet: You're so still, {name}, I could animate you. Don't worry, I won't, yet.
lines.tease_talker: You'd be a terrible puppet, {name}, you'd never hold a pose.
lines.tease_careful: A millimetre at a time, {name}, that's how you move. You'd make a lovely stop-motion character.
lines.tease_bold: You move like a puppet with the strings cut, {name}. Very dramatic, very short-lived.
lines.tease_any: My crow likes you, {name}, and it doesn't like anybody, so I'm suspicious.
lines.tease_back: Ha, jó, {name}, that was a good one. My crow laughed too.
lines.bristle: Please don't, {name}. Leave that one in its grave.
lines.apologise: That was nastier than I meant, and I'm sorry. My jokes go wrong sometimes.
lines.double_down: That one stays, it was a good line.
lines.needle_quiet: You never move until it's too late. Even my puppets had more timing.
lines.needle_talker: My crow's started hiding from your talking. That takes effort.
lines.needle_careful: You take forever, na, and the scene's over before you move.
lines.needle_bold: You flail about like bad animation. Weight, timing, follow-through, please.
lines.needle_any: You call what I do evil, and you've never once watched it properly.
lines.bite_back: I've made dead things move beautifully for years. Don't lecture me about control.
lines.hurt: Ah, that one landed, I'll admit it. I'll go and sulk with my crow.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, festival critics were far nastier, na, and my film still won. Come on, then.
lines.confide: {name}, my father ran a little puppet theatre, and I grew up backstage watching him bring wooden things to life. I started making films because it was the closest thing to what he did.
lines.listen: My crow and I are both listening, {name}. Neither of us will tell anyone.
lines.look_out: Stay where my crow can see you in there, {name}. It'll tell me if you're in trouble.
lines.accept: Jó, {name}, your way. I'll follow the script.
lines.deflect: Na, it's a scratch, {name}. My crow's had worse, and it's dead.
lines.check_in: Hold still, {name}, and show me where. Small adjustments are my speciality.
lines.blame: Somebody moved without timing in there, and the whole scene fell apart.
lines.thank: I was nearly one of my own puppets there. Köszönöm, thank you.
lines.brush_off: Na, it's nothing, just a small adjustment. Sit still for me.
lines.worry: Na, {name}, that was far too dramatic. Sit down, I'm checking you over.
lines.handed_down: Na, so now I'm in your gear. It'll stay in better shape than my puppets.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, jó, it suits you. I've got my mannequin.
lines.hand_sulk: So nobody asked me. My crow's offended on my behalf.
lines.turn_friendly: My crow's decided you're all right, {name}, and so have I.
lines.turn_friends: You can help with my moving picture, {name}. Nobody else gets to touch the frames.
lines.turn_grating: It's not good between us, na. Fine, my crow doesn't like you either.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still raise what we need, it's my craft. Don't expect a cartoon.
lines.make_up: This is silly, {name}, na. Let's start the scene again.
lines.defend: That's nonsense, and I saw it all. Back off from {name}.
lines.friend_left: My crow keeps looking for {name}, who's gone home for a while.
lines.friend_back: Look who's back, {name}! My crow's learned a new hop, come and see.
lines.common_craft: Twelve years moving puppets a millimetre at a time. Anybody who makes things by hand knows the patience is the whole art.
lines.common_animals: My crow, and before it my cat Kocka, who hated every puppet I ever made. Animals are the best critics.
